title: Everyday Phrases — At a Concert
scene_zh: 看演唱會 · 情境對話
title_quote: Did the concert presale start yet?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🎤 實用看演唱會必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱B1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — At a Concert
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用看演唱會情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical At a Concert phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the concert presale start yet?
dialogue.zh: 演唱會預售開始了還沒？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It starts this Friday at eight sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɑrts ðɪs ˈfraɪdeɪ æt eɪt ʃɑrp./
dialogue.zh: 這週五晚上八點整開搶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This website is already so slow.
dialogue.zh: 網站已經卡得不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone refreshes at the same time.
dialogue.zh: 大家都在同一時間刷新嘛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which ticket tier looks good?
dialogue.zh: 哪個票檔看起來不錯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheap seats are almost sold out.
dialogue.zh: 便宜那檔快賣光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are side seats worth buying?
dialogue.zh: 側面座位值得買嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are cheaper but still fun.
dialogue.zh: 便宜些，但一樣好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I chose the middle tier seats.
dialogue.zh: 我選了中間價位的座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart pick, the view is fine.
dialogue.zh: 選得好，視野應該沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I add ticket insurance?
dialogue.zh: 開搶前要加買購票保險嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It only costs a few dollars.
dialogue.zh: 只要幾塊錢而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What exactly does it cover?
dialogue.zh: 它到底保些什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Refunds when you cannot attend.
dialogue.zh: 去不了的時候可以退票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Skip it, I plan to go.
dialogue.zh: 不買了吧，我一定去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your call, I will keep mine.
dialogue.zh: 你決定，我的還是保著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I buy two tickets?
dialogue.zh: 我要買兩張票嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will pay for mine.
dialogue.zh: 好，我自己付我那張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My card failed at checkout.
dialogue.zh: 我結帳時刷卡失敗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try again, seats get released.
dialogue.zh: 再試試，會有人釋出座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two seats just opened in our section.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu sits dʒʌst ˈoʊpənd ɪn ˈaʊər ˈsɛkʃən./
dialogue.zh: 我們那個區剛放出兩個位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grab them before they disappear!
dialogue.zh: 快搶，趁還沒被人搶走！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got them, section G, row nine.
dialogue.zh: 搶到了，G區第九排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wow, that is really lucky!
dialogue.zh: 哇，你也太幸運了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My confirmation email just arrived.
dialogue.zh: 確認信剛剛收到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine came one minute ago.
dialogue.zh: 我的一分鐘前就到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So there is nothing to print?
dialogue.zh: 所以不用列印任何東西？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just show the QR code.
dialogue.zh: 不用，出示手機上的掃描碼就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if my phone dies early?
dialogue.zh: 手機萬一很早就沒電怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring a small power bank.
dialogue.zh: 帶個小型行動電源吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend cannot go anymore.
dialogue.zh: 我朋友去不了了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So her ticket is free now?
dialogue.zh: 那她的票就空出來了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app allows transfers for free.
dialogue.zh: App 上轉讓是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, send it to my account.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，轉到我的帳戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The transfer shows accepted now.
dialogue.zh: 轉讓狀態顯示已接收。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, it scans right at the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt, ɪt skænz raɪt æt ðə ɡeɪt./
dialogue.zh: 好，進場時直接掃就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, the ticket still shows her name.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, ðə ˈtɪkɪt stɪl ʃoʊz hɜr neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 等等，那張票上還是她的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does that cause a problem?
dialogue.zh: 這樣會有問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rules say names can change.
dialogue.zh: 規則說姓名可以改。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, update it before we leave.
dialogue.zh: 好，出發前先在 App 改好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The venue is far from downtown.
dialogue.zh: 場館離市區挺遠的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should we drive or take the train?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi draɪv ɔr teɪk ðə treɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 我們是開車還是坐捷運？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The train stops right beside it.
dialogue.zh: 捷運站就在場館旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then skip the parking fees.
dialogue.zh: 那就別花停車費了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Parking near the arena costs a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɑrkɪŋ nɪr ði əˈrinə kɔsts ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 場館附近停車很貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I read it adds twenty dollars.
dialogue.zh: 我看還要多花二十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The show ends really late.
dialogue.zh: 演出結束得挺晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe book a hotel nearby.
dialogue.zh: 要不在附近訂間飯店。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is one across the street.
dialogue.zh: 街對面就有一家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is it still free that show night?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt stɪl fri ðæt ʃoʊ naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 演出那晚還有空房嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Prices jump on concert nights.
dialogue.zh: 演唱會那晚房價會暴漲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We could share one bigger room.
dialogue.zh: 我們可以合住一間大房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I found a cheaper place downtown.
dialogue.zh: 我在市區找到便宜些的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does it offer a shuttle bus?
dialogue.zh: 它有接駁車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it runs straight to the venue.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt rʌnz streɪt tu ðə ˈvɛnu./
dialogue.zh: 有，直接開到場館門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That settles it, we stay there.
dialogue.zh: 那就這麼定了，住那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time should we leave home?
dialogue.zh: 我們該幾點出門？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Doors open at seven, right?
dialogue.zh: 七點開放入場，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Merch lines form before doors.
dialogue.zh: 周邊攤在開放入場前就排隊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us get there by seven.
dialogue.zh: 那我們七點前到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bring a folding chair?
dialogue.zh: 我要帶把摺疊椅嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only GA fans need those.
dialogue.zh: 只有內場歌迷才需要那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: General admission enters first.
dialogue.zh: 自由席會第一批放行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So early birds get front spots.
dialogue.zh: 所以早到能卡到前排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel nervous about the rush.
dialogue.zh: 一想到搶進場就緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just stay calm and follow staff.
dialogue.zh: 冷靜，聽工作人員安排就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you hear well from far seats?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju hɪr wɛl frʌm fɑr sits?/
dialogue.zh: 坐得遠也聽得清楚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the mix reaches every seat.
dialogue.zh: 可以，混音每個位子都聽得清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wear my tour shirt?
dialogue.zh: 我該穿我的巡演T恤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, fans wear theirs every night.
dialogue.zh: 要啊，歌迷每場都穿自己的那件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It might get hot inside though.
dialogue.zh: 不過場內可能會很熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Layers help, the hall gets warm.
dialogue.zh: 穿多幾層有用，場內會暖起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Comfortable shoes are the rule.
dialogue.zh: 舒適的鞋是鐵則。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, we stand for hours there.
dialogue.zh: 對，在裡面要站好幾個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you see the VIP package?
dialogue.zh: 你看到 VIP 套票了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It includes early sound check entry.
dialogue.zh: 裡面含提前進場看彩排試音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That package costs triple the price.
dialogue.zh: 那套票要三倍價錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Super fans say it is worth it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsupər fænz seɪ ɪt ɪz wɜrθ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 鐵粉都說很值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our seats sit in section G.
dialogue.zh: 我們的座位在 G 區。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At least we have a full view.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt list wi hæv ə fʊl vju./
dialogue.zh: 至少視野很完整。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tier three sold out in minutes.
dialogue.zh: 第三檔幾分鐘就秒殺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lucky we grabbed ours at eight.
dialogue.zh: 幸好我們八點準時搶到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Resale sites list nearby seats now.
dialogue.zh: 二手網站上有鄰近座位了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, some listings are fake.
dialogue.zh: 小心，有些賣的是假票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I bought only from official pages.
dialogue.zh: 我只在官方頁面買票。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, scalper tickets can get canceled.
dialogue.zh: 對，黃牛票可能會被作廢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I lose my e-ticket?
dialogue.zh: 電子票萬一弄丟了怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can restore it in the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn rɪˈstɔr ɪt ɪn ði æp./
dialogue.zh: 在 App 裡就能恢復回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the app wants a fresh sign-in.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ði æp wɑnts ə frɛʃ saɪn ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 現在 App 要求重新登入。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the same email as your order.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə seɪm ˈimel æz jʊr ˈɔrdər./
dialogue.zh: 用下單時那個信箱登入。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, my order history works.
dialogue.zh: 找到了，訂單記錄打得開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Phew, that worry was real.
dialogue.zh: 呼，剛剛真的嚇到我了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I keep my ticket for memories?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ kip maɪ ˈtɪkɪt fər ˈmɛməriz?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以留這張票當紀念嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, it looks great on a wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, ɪt lʊks ɡreɪt ɑn ə wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 當然，貼在牆上超好看的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The code refreshes before entry.
dialogue.zh: 入場前掃描碼會自動更新。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So screenshots never actually work.
dialogue.zh: 所以截個畫面根本沒用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One friend still needs a seat.
dialogue.zh: 有個朋友還沒買到位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lucky for her, I hold that ticket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌki fɔr hɜr, aɪ hoʊld ðæt ˈtɪkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 算她運氣好，那張票還在我手上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then transfer it to her today.
dialogue.zh: 那就今天轉讓給她。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, our group is whole again.
dialogue.zh: 搞定，我們這群人又齊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is packed out here already.
dialogue.zh: 場館這邊外面已經擠滿人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This line wraps around the block.
dialogue.zh: 這段隊伍繞了整個街區一圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is this wait?
dialogue.zh: 這段隊伍要排多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe forty more minutes.
dialogue.zh: 大概還要四十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the security line?
dialogue.zh: 這是安檢隊伍嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, stand behind the yellow tape.
dialogue.zh: 對，請站在黃線後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we open our bags here?
dialogue.zh: 包要在這裡打開檢查嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they peek inside each bag.
dialogue.zh: 對，進門時會翻包檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My backpack looks too big.
dialogue.zh: 我的背包好像太大了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rent a locker outside the gate.
dialogue.zh: 可以在閘口外面租寄物櫃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I bring my water bottle?
dialogue.zh: 我可以帶自己的水瓶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only sealed water goes in.
dialogue.zh: 只有未開封的水能帶進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about snacks from the car?
dialogue.zh: 車裡拿出來的零食呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Food gets collected at the door.
dialogue.zh: 食物會在門口被收走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are cameras prohibited too?
dialogue.zh: 相機也不能帶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big camera lenses are not allowed.
dialogue.zh: 大鏡頭不準帶入場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So phones only for photos?
dialogue.zh: 所以只能用手機拍照？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, phone photos are enough tonight.
dialogue.zh: 對，今晚用手機拍拍就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wand beeped at my keys.
dialogue.zh: 探測棒對我的鑰匙叫了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put them in the tray first.
dialogue.zh: 先把它們放進托盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I take off my hat?
dialogue.zh: 帽子也要摘下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, along with your jacket.
dialogue.zh: 對，外套也一起脫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A guard checked my backpack.
dialogue.zh: 一位保全檢查了我的背包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He just wanted a quick look.
dialogue.zh: 他只是想快速看一眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was smoother than expected.
dialogue.zh: 比想像中順利多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, no need to worry.
dialogue.zh: 看吧，不用擔心的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is section G located?
dialogue.zh: G區在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the stairs on your right.
dialogue.zh: 走你右邊的樓梯上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This ramp leads to the upper level.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ræmp lidz tu ði ˈʌpər ˈlɛvəl./
dialogue.zh: 這條坡道是通往上層的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow the arrow signs upstairs.
dialogue.zh: 跟著箭頭指示往上走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our seats are nine and ten.
dialogue.zh: 我們的座位是九號和十號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, ours are right beside you.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我的座位就在你旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we go into the standing area?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi ɡoʊ ˈɪntu ðə ˈstændɪŋ ˈɛriə?/
dialogue.zh: 我們能去站立區嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That pit needs a special ticket.
dialogue.zh: 內場區要專用的票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the floor pit completely sold out?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə flɔr pɪt kəmˈplitli soʊld aʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 內場票已經完全賣光了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it filled up within minutes.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，幾分鐘就滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The view from here is amazing.
dialogue.zh: 從這裡的視野太棒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The stage looks so close.
dialogue.zh: 舞台看起來好近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glad we picked these seats.
dialogue.zh: 還好我們選了這些位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally worth the higher price.
dialogue.zh: 完全值得多花的錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a merch stand downstairs.
dialogue.zh: 樓下有周邊商品攤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us visit before the show.
dialogue.zh: 開場前先去逛逛吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which counter is the official store?
dialogue.zh: 哪個櫃台是官方商店？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The big one near the main gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɪɡ wʌn nɪr ðə meɪn ɡeɪt./
dialogue.zh: 正門旁邊那頂大的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the tour towel?
dialogue.zh: 巡演毛巾多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It costs twenty-five dollars each.
dialogue.zh: 一條二十五美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will grab one for you.
dialogue.zh: 我幫你拿一條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get the black one, please.
dialogue.zh: 請幫我拿黑色那款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they sell light sticks?
dialogue.zh: 他們有賣應援棒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they glow in many colors.
dialogue.zh: 有，會亮很多顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the stick included with tickets?
dialogue.zh: 應援棒是買票就送嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you buy it separately.
dialogue.zh: 不是，要另外購買。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This poster design looks so cool.
dialogue.zh: 這張海報設計好酷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grab one, the good prints go fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡræb wʌn, ðə ɡʊd prɪnts ɡoʊ fæst./
dialogue.zh: 快拿一張，好看的款式一下就沒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want the T-shirt in large.
dialogue.zh: 我要大號的T恤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try medium, it runs pretty big.
dialogue.zh: 試試中號吧，版型偏大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay by phone here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡可以用手機付款嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They take cards and mobile pay.
dialogue.zh: 卡和手機支付都收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This shirt line looks endless.
dialogue.zh: 買T恤的隊伍看起來沒完。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We could order online for pickup.
dialogue.zh: 我們可以線上訂、現場取。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this tote bag on sale?
dialogue.zh: 這個托特包有促銷嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is a limited edition item.
dialogue.zh: 這是限量款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Limited means it sells out fast.
dialogue.zh: 限量就代表一下架就光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I am buying two today.
dialogue.zh: 那我今天要買兩個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My pickup order shows it unavailable.
dialogue.zh: 我的現場取貨訂單顯示缺貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They restock at intermission sometimes.
dialogue.zh: 有時中場休息會補貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which gate goes to section G?
dialogue.zh: 哪個閘口通到 G 區？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The signs point to gates C and D.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə saɪnz pɔɪnt tu ɡeɪts si ænd di./
dialogue.zh: 指標寫著 C 與 D 閘口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gate C is closed right now.
dialogue.zh: C入口現在關閉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move to D, the line is shorter.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv tu di, ðə laɪn ɪz ˈʃɔrtər./
dialogue.zh: 改去D口，那邊隊伍短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The scanner beeped green for us.
dialogue.zh: 掃描器為我們亮綠燈了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are in, find your seat number.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ər ɪn, faɪnd jʊr sit ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 進去啦，快找你的座位號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone sits in my chair already.
dialogue.zh: 有人已經坐在我的位子上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check your row number one more time.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk jʊr roʊ ˈnʌmbər wʌn mɔr taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 再確認一次你的排數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine says nine, this one says ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn sɛz naɪn, ðɪs wʌn sɛz tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 我的是九號，這張寫十號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, the numbers look alike.
dialogue.zh: 看吧，兩個號碼長得很像。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ushers can help us switch seats.
dialogue.zh: 引導員可以幫我們協調座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask one in a bright yellow vest.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk wʌn ɪn ə braɪt ˈjɛloʊ vɛst./
dialogue.zh: 去問穿亮黃背心那位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lights just dimmed a little.
dialogue.zh: 燈光剛剛暗了一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone is standing up already!
dialogue.zh: 大家全都已經站起來了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we hide our drinks?
dialogue.zh: 我們的飲料要收起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cups stay under the seat here.
dialogue.zh: 這裡杯子要放在座位下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are phones okay during songs?
dialogue.zh: 唱歌的時候可以用手機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but keep the flash off.
dialogue.zh: 可以，但要把閃光燈關掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did security take my lighter?
dialogue.zh: 安檢把我的打火機收走了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they collect all banned items.
dialogue.zh: 對，違禁品都會代管。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bag was searched quickly.
dialogue.zh: 我的包一下子就檢查完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They check every single guest.
dialogue.zh: 每位觀眾都要過檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time I will carry less metal.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm aɪ wɪl ˈkæri lɛs ˈmɛtəl./
dialogue.zh: 下次我要少帶點金屬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, my rings set it off.
dialogue.zh: 真的，我的戒指也嗶了一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need the restroom before it starts.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid ðə ˈrɛstrum bɪˈfɔr ɪt stɑrts./
dialogue.zh: 開演前我得先去廁所。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow the signs to the left.
dialogue.zh: 跟著左邊的指標走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need earplugs, this hall gets loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid ˈɪrˌplʌɡz ðɪs hɔl ɡɛts laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 我需要耳塞，這個場館音量超大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Merch stands sell the soft kind.
dialogue.zh: 周邊攤有賣軟式耳塞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do these block all the noise?
dialogue.zh: 這種會把聲音全擋掉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They soften sound, keep music clear.
dialogue.zh: 只會減弱音量，音樂還是清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time is the main set?
dialogue.zh: 主秀幾點開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine, right after the opener ends.
dialogue.zh: 九點，暖場團結束就上場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The opening band sounds really good.
dialogue.zh: 暖場樂團聽起來真不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A nice bonus before the main act.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə naɪs ˈboʊnəs bɪˈfɔr ðə meɪn ækt./
dialogue.zh: 主秀前的額外小驚喜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The crowd is screaming so loud!
dialogue.zh: 全場尖叫得好大聲！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here they come, the band appears!
dialogue.zh: 他們來了，樂團出場了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I cannot believe this opening song.
dialogue.zh: 不敢相信開場曲是這一首。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am so excited right now.
dialogue.zh: 我現在興奮得不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stand up, do not stay seated.
dialogue.zh: 站起來，別坐著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am already on my feet.
dialogue.zh: 我早就已經站起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone knows these lyrics already.
dialogue.zh: 這些歌詞大家早就都會了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us just sing along together.
dialogue.zh: 我們一起大聲跟著唱吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold your phone up with light.
dialogue.zh: 把手機的燈光舉起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The whole hall looks like stars.
dialogue.zh: 全場看起來像一片星海。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is recording the full show okay?
dialogue.zh: 錄下整場演出可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Filming entire sets is not allowed.
dialogue.zh: 錄滿全場是不被允許的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will just film this chorus.
dialogue.zh: 那我就只錄這段副歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save some moments for your eyes.
dialogue.zh: 留一些畫面用眼睛收藏吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This next one is a classic.
dialogue.zh: 下一首是他們的經典曲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The whole crowd is clapping along.
dialogue.zh: 全場觀眾都跟著拍手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The guitarist is playing beautifully.
dialogue.zh: 吉他手彈得太美了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That solo section was unreal.
dialogue.zh: 那段獨奏簡直不真實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you hear the bass drum?
dialogue.zh: 你聽得到大鼓的聲音嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I feel it right in my chest.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fil ɪt raɪt ɪn maɪ tʃɛst./
dialogue.zh: 我整個胸口都在震動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The singer walked into the crowd.
dialogue.zh: 主唱走進觀眾席了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fans leaned close just to wave.
dialogue.zh: 粉絲探著身子，只為揮個手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the floor is all I see.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə flɔr ɪz ɔl aɪ si./
dialogue.zh: 我現在低頭只看到人頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try standing carefully between seats.
dialogue.zh: 試試在座位縫隙間小心站高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it safe to climb up here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt seɪf tə klaɪm ʌp hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 站在這裡看安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An usher asked us both to sit down.
dialogue.phonetic: /æn ˈʌʃər æskt ʌs boθ tə sɪt daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 引導員剛剛請我們兩個坐好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They opened a song request board.
dialogue.zh: 現場開放了歌迷點歌看板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shout the title you want most.
dialogue.zh: 大聲喊出你最想聽的那首。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone yelled the band's hometown song.
dialogue.zh: 有人喊了跟他們家鄉有關的那首。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The band really played it!
dialogue.zh: 樂團竟然真的唱了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is the best night ever.
dialogue.zh: 這是我最棒的一個夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I got goosebumps from song two.
dialogue.zh: 從第二首起我就一直起雞皮疙瘩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The band just left the stage, is that all?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bænd dʒʌst lɛft ðə steɪdʒ, ɪz ðæt ɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 樂團剛下台，就這樣結束了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We must chant to bring them back.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi mʌst tʃænt tə brɪŋ ðɛm bæk./
dialogue.zh: 我們要喊安可把他們請回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clap on the beat with me.
dialogue.zh: 跟著我一起拍手打拍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The clapping is growing louder.
dialogue.zh: 拍手聲越來越響亮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They ran back onto the stage!
dialogue.zh: 他們跑回舞台上了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The final song begins right now.
dialogue.zh: 最後一首現在就開演。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Confetti fell over the front rows.
dialogue.zh: 彩色紙片飄滿了前排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It landed in my hair too.
dialogue.zh: 我頭髮上也落了一片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The last note just rang out.
dialogue.zh: 最後一個音剛剛落下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The crowd roared for ten seconds.
dialogue.zh: 全場歡呼了整整十秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My voice is completely gone.
dialogue.zh: 我的嗓子完全唱啞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I whisper now but feel happy.
dialogue.zh: 我現在只能用氣音，但超開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That balloon dropped onto our row.
dialogue.zh: 那個氣球掉到我們這一排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Someone threw it straight back.
dialogue.zh: 有人直接把它拋了回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do people really cry at concerts?
dialogue.zh: 演唱會上真的有人會哭嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The man beside us definitely did.
dialogue.zh: 我們旁邊那位先生剛剛就哭了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you pass a tissue please?
dialogue.zh: 可以幫我抽張衛生紙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, take this whole little pack.
dialogue.zh: 給，這一整小包都拿去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I cannot remember this song title.
dialogue.zh: 我想不起這首歌的歌名了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is their old love ballad.
dialogue.zh: 是他們那首老情歌啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My ears are ringing a little.
dialogue.zh: 我的耳朵有點在耳鳴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sound was super powerful tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚的音浪真的太猛了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us stretch our legs a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs strɛt ˈɑʊr lɛɡz ə ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我們先伸個幾分鐘的腿吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good call, the wait may take a while.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kɔl, ðə weɪt meɪ teɪk ə waɪl./
dialogue.zh: 好主意，安可等待可能還要一陣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The volume out here feels huge.
dialogue.zh: 在場外還是覺得音量好大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: These walls absorb some of it.
dialogue.zh: 這些牆有吸掉一部分聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put in your soft earplugs now.
dialogue.zh: 快把軟的耳塞戴上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my ears feel calmer.
dialogue.zh: 好多了，耳朵舒服一些了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the second encore coming tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚會有第二次安可嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lights are low, so probably.
dialogue.zh: 燈還暗著，應該會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I cannot jump another minute.
dialogue.zh: 我一分鐘都再跳不動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save energy for the last chorus.
dialogue.zh: 留點體力給最後的副歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The drummer held a stick up high.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdrʌmər hɛld ə stɪk ʌp haɪ./
dialogue.zh: 鼓手把鼓棒高高舉起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fans threw light sticks on stage.
dialogue.zh: 粉絲把應援棒丟向舞台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is throwing things there safe?
dialogue.zh: 往台上丟東西這樣安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Staff catch and return each one.
dialogue.zh: 工作人員會接住再丟回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wave your towel during the bridge.
dialogue.zh: 間奏時要揮舞你的毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is how local fans do it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz haʊ ˈloʊkəl fænz du ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 在地粉絲都是這樣應援的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen shows the crowd now.
dialogue.zh: 大螢幕現在開始轉播觀眾席。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is our whole row on camera!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ɑʊr hoʊl roʊ ɑn ˈkæmərə!/
dialogue.zh: 我們整排都上鏡頭了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you see us waving there?
dialogue.zh: 你有看到我們在鏡頭前揮手嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We looked silly and totally happy.
dialogue.zh: 我們看起來傻氣但超幸福。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lead sang toward our side.
dialogue.zh: 主唱朝著我們這一邊唱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I put my phone down to watch.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pʊt maɪ foʊn daʊn tə wɑtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 我放下手機，專心用眼睛看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Watching beats any phone video.
dialogue.zh: 現場看勝過任何手機錄影。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the wisest line tonight.
dialogue.zh: 這是你今晚說過最有智慧的一句。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The house lights came fully on.
dialogue.zh: 場燈終於全部亮了起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The show is over, what a night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃoʊ ɪz ˈoʊvər, wʌt ə naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 演出結束了，多麼難忘的一晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Applaud the crew as they leave.
dialogue.zh: 工作人員退場時也給他們掌聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They carried speakers all afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 他們搬音箱搬了整個下午。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I still cannot catch my breath.
dialogue.zh: 我還是有點喘不過氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit down, drink a little water.
dialogue.zh: 先坐下，喝一點水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My feet hurt after all that standing.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ fit hɜrt ˈæftər ɔl ðæt ˈstændɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 站了那麼久，我的腳好痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hours of jumping does that.
dialogue.zh: 蹦蹦跳跳兩小時當然會這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did that guitar solo really happen?
dialogue.zh: 那段吉他獨奏真的發生過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am still living inside it.
dialogue.zh: 我的靈魂還泡在那段旋律裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hall echo sounds different now.
dialogue.zh: 現在場館的回聲聽起來不一樣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Empty seats make it feel strange.
dialogue.zh: 空掉的座位讓一切變得奇妙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we rush toward the exit?
dialogue.zh: 我們要趕緊往出口衝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the walkout takes forever anyway.
dialogue.zh: 不用，反正怎麼走都很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone moves in one slow wave.
dialogue.zh: 大家像一道慢浪一樣往前移。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody runs, the crowd just drifts.
dialogue.zh: 沒有人跑步，人潮只是緩緩漂動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They announced the winter tour tonight.
dialogue.zh: 他們今晚宣佈了冬季巡演。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The whole arena cheered at the news.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊl əˈrinə tʃɪrd æt ðə nuz./
dialogue.zh: 全場聽到消息都歡呼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My chest still feels like thunder.
dialogue.zh: 我胸口還像打雷一樣震動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is pure music energy left.
dialogue.zh: 那是音樂留下來還在的餘震。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Best concert night of my life.
dialogue.zh: 這是我人生最棒的演唱會之夜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same here, let us do this again.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm hɪr, lɛt ʌs du ðɪs əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，我們一定要再來一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The arena doors just swung open.
dialogue.zh: 場館大門剛剛全推開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A river of people flows out.
dialogue.zh: 人潮像河水一樣湧出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone walks the same direction.
dialogue.zh: 所有人都往同一個方向走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow the crowd to the main road.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɑloʊ ðə kraʊd tu ðə meɪn roʊd./
dialogue.zh: 跟著人潮走到大馬路那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone shows terrible battery.
dialogue.zh: 我手機的電量慘不忍睹。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten percent left, save it for the ride.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn pərˈsɛnt lɛft, seɪv ɪt fɔr ðə raɪd./
dialogue.zh: 只剩百分之十，留著回家路上用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the streets closed around here?
dialogue.zh: 這附近的街道封起來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, police blocked cars near the arena.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, pəˈlis blɑkt kɑrz nɪr ði əˈrinə./
dialogue.zh: 對，警方封了場館周邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rideshare prices just doubled again.
dialogue.zh: 叫車費用又直接翻倍了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us walk to the next station.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs wɔk tu ðə nɛkst ˈsteɪʃən./
dialogue.zh: 我們走到下一站再搭車吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The train platform is fully packed.
dialogue.zh: 月台上已經擠得水泄不通。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Extra cars arrived just for tonight.
dialogue.zh: 加掛的車廂就是為今晚開的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The road ahead is full of cars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə roʊd əˈhɛd ɪz fʊl ʌv kɑrz./
dialogue.zh: 前面的道路上全是車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Taxis queue along the second block.
dialogue.zh: 計程車在第二個街口排著隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we wait out the surge?
dialogue.zh: 我們要等漲價時段過去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Prices drop in about an hour.
dialogue.zh: 大約一小時後價格就會降。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our hotel shuttle already left.
dialogue.zh: 飯店接駁車剛剛開走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is another one in ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz əˈnʌðər wʌn ɪn tɛn ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘後還有一班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My ears still buzz on the train.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ɪrz stɪl bʌz ɑn ðə treɪn./
dialogue.zh: 坐在捷運上我的耳朵還在嗡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, everything sounds far away.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，什麼都聽起來遠遠的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you buy the tour poster?
dialogue.zh: 你有買到巡演的海報嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they went at seven sharp.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，七點整就賣光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The vinyl record was gone too.
dialogue.zh: 黑膠唱片也完售了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The stand posted a restock notice.
dialogue.zh: 攤位上貼了補貨通知。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the online shop restock Friday?
dialogue.zh: 線上商店週五會補貨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The next drop is coming Friday.
dialogue.zh: 下一批開賣是週五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we still order the hoodie?
dialogue.zh: 連帽衫還訂得到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only small sizes are left for now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli smɔl ˈsaɪzərz ər lɛft fɔr naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 目前只剩小尺寸能預購。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I regret that missed light stick.
dialogue.zh: 好後悔沒買到那支應援棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The encore cart had extra ones.
dialogue.zh: 安可時周邊推車有補貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You mean after the final song?
dialogue.zh: 你是說最後安可那首之後嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, near the side exit gate.
dialogue.zh: 對，就在側邊出口附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too late now, the cart is gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu leɪt naʊ, ðə kɑrt ɪz ɡɑn./
dialogue.zh: 現在太晚了，推車都收攤了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the official store tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 明天上官方商城看看好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us recap the whole night.
dialogue.zh: 我們來復盤一下今晚吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with the amazing encore moment.
dialogue.zh: 先從那個超神的安可瞬間說起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The set list leaked online already.
dialogue.zh: 今晚的歌單已經在網上流出了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They played two big surprise songs.
dialogue.zh: 他們加唱了兩首驚喜曲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will make a photo album.
dialogue.zh: 我要把照片做成一個相簿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tag me in that blurry dance shot.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæɡ mi ɪn ðæt ˈblɜri dæns ʃɑt./
dialogue.zh: 那張模糊的跳舞照要標記我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which song was your favorite?
dialogue.zh: 你最喜歡哪一首？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The acoustic version blew me away.
dialogue.zh: 不插電版本完全把我震住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That singer hit every single note.
dialogue.zh: 那位歌手每個音都唱穩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Live shows beat recordings every time.
dialogue.zh: 現場永遠勝過錄音檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should compare our two receipts.
dialogue.zh: 我們該比對一下兩張收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One receipt charge looks too high.
dialogue.zh: 有張收據的金額看起來偏高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did they add a booking fee?
dialogue.zh: 他們加了訂票手續費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it printed on the bottom line.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt prɪntɪd ɑn ðə ˈbɑtəm laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 有，印在最下面那一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that is normal for shows.
dialogue.zh: 哦，演唱會都是這樣的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then our total actually matches.
dialogue.zh: 那我們的總額對得上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My earplug case is missing now.
dialogue.zh: 我的耳塞盒現在不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you leave it at your seats?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju liv ɪt æt jʊr sits?/
dialogue.zh: 會不會落在你們座位上了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe, I hope staff found it.
dialogue.zh: 說不定，希望工作人員撿到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The office is by the east gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɔfɪs ɪz baɪ ði ist ɡeɪt./
dialogue.zh: 服務處就在東門旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A guard filled a claim slip out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡɑrd fɪld ə kleɪm slɪp aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 一位保全幫我填了領取單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It lists every item found so far.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lɪsts ˈɛvri ˈaɪtəm faʊnd soʊ fɑr./
dialogue.zh: 上面登記著目前撿到的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone turned in a black case.
dialogue.zh: 有人交了一個黑色的收納盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is not yours, right.
dialogue.zh: 那張不是你的，對吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, mine was bright blue.
dialogue.zh: 不是，我的是亮藍色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep hoping, bins fill after shows.
dialogue.zh: 別灰心，散場後招領箱會堆滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh! It was in my jacket.
dialogue.zh: 喔！原來在我外套裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, nothing lost after all.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，什麼都沒丟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our bags are at the hotel desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈbæɡz ər æt ðə ˈhoʊtɛl dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 我們的行李放在飯店櫃台了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, we can rest before sleep.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，睡前可以先躺一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow we leave after brunch.
dialogue.zh: 明天我們吃完早午餐再出發。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more late morning, please.
dialogue.zh: 請讓我再賴一個上午。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tour announced more dates tonight.
dialogue.zh: 巡演今晚又公佈了新場次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next spring adds two home cities.
dialogue.zh: 明年春天加場我們家鄉兩個城市。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do we get presale access?
dialogue.zh: 要怎樣才能拿到預售資格？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Join their official fan mailing list.
dialogue.zh: 加入官方俱樂部的會員名單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I signed up, the inbox confirmed.
dialogue.zh: 我登記了，信箱收到確認信。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Presale codes arrive two days before.
dialogue.zh: 預售序號會提前兩天寄到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set a reminder for ticket day.
dialogue.zh: 記得幫開票日設個提醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I already set an alarm for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɔlˈrɛdi sɛt æn əˈlɑrm fɔr ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我已經為開搶那天設好鬧鐘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we pick seats in advance?
dialogue.zh: 我們要提前先選座位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same section as tonight, right?
dialogue.zh: 跟今晚一樣的區域，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Section G worked out perfectly.
dialogue.zh: G 區的位置非常完美。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we repeat that exact choice.
dialogue.zh: 那我們下次就照這個訂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friends asked about spare tickets.
dialogue.zh: 朋友們在問還有沒有多餘票。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can transfer ours that easily.
dialogue.zh: 我們的票轉讓起來很容易。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us plan a group this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs plæn ə ɡrup ðɪs taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 這次我們乾脆組團去吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six of us makes the trip fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ʌv ʌs meɪks ðə trɪp fʌn./
dialogue.zh: 六個人一起出發會更好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stadium shows are even bigger.
dialogue.zh: 體育場的場次規模更大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But the sound may feel thinner there.
dialogue.phonetic: /bət ðə saʊnd me fil ˈθɪnər ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 但那邊音響效果可能比較稀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we buy the festival pass?
dialogue.zh: 我們要買音樂季通票嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It covers three bands in one day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈkʌvərz θri bændz ɪn wʌn deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 一張通票一天能看三團。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds like a fun deal.
dialogue.zh: 聽起來真的很划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Camping gets included with the pass too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæmpɪŋ ɡɛts ɪnˈkluːdɪd wɪð ðə pæs tu./
dialogue.zh: 通票還附了露營的位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe skip camping, book small cabins.
dialogue.zh: 露營就算了吧，訂小木屋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cabins fill before tickets usually.
dialogue.zh: 木屋通常比門票先完售。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every detail matters for tour trips.
dialogue.zh: 追巡演的每個細節都很重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is what makes a night great.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz wʌt meɪks ə naɪt ɡreɪt./
dialogue.zh: 但那正是難忘的原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I already miss the crowd energy.
dialogue.zh: 我已經開始想念全場的氣氛了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The photos will keep that feeling.
dialogue.zh: 照片會幫我們留住那種感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight was pure magic.
dialogue.zh: 今晚就像一場魔法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep now, we earned this rest.
dialogue.zh: 快睡吧，這份休息是我們掙來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same seats on the next tour, promise?
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm sits ɑn ðə nɛkst tʊr, ˈprɑmɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 下次巡演還坐一樣的位子，說好了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Promise, I will guard both tickets.
dialogue.zh: 說好了，兩張票我會看牢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, rest well after that show.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt, rɛst wɛl ˈæftər ðæt ʃoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 晚安，看完演唱會好好休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, dream of music and sleep well now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt, drim ʌv ˈmjuzɪk ænd slip wɛl naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 晚安，在音樂裡入夢，好好睡。
